description: Explain and fix an error: finds matching GitHub issues and Stack Overflow questions (like /error/known), reads the top accepted answers in full, then writes the likely cause and concrete fix steps citing those sources, and says plainly when nothing matching was found. Paste the error (stack traces fine) and optionally the library. Price: $0.03 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, crates (Rust) or go (Go modules).

library.description: The package the error comes from, to search its own issues first.

message.description: The error message (a stack trace is fine; paths and line numbers are stripped).

name: error-explain

explanation.description: Markdown: likely cause and fix, citing matches as [n].

relevance.description: Share of the error's words found in the match (0-1).

status.description: open / closed / accepted answer / answered / unanswered.

query.description: The cleaned-up phrase that was searched.

title: Error explain ($0.03)
